newsitem.title: USA: Jordan buys 18,803 T California medium grain rice.
newsitem.headline: Jordan buys 18,803 T California medium grain rice.

text.p: Jordan bought 18,803 tonnes U.S. medium grain rice under the PL 480, Title I export program, its U.S. export agent and U.S. exporters said.
The deal includes 6,300 tonnes at $421 a tonne, FAS (free along side) Sacramento, Ca., 5,250 tonnes at $425 a tonne, and 2,003 tonnes at $427, all from Commodity Specialists.
Another 5,250 tonnes at $422.65 a tonne was from Granplex Inc. The rice quality is U.S. No. 1 Calrose, four percent broken, milled in 50 kg bags.
Shipment period is set for November 15-30.
